description: This file defines a CameraHandler class responsible for managing camera operations such as listing devices, taking snapshots, and recording clips in an Android app. It includes logging, error handling, size limitations for clips, and interfaces with camera hardware and UI feedback.

classes.name: CameraHandler
classes.description: A class that handles camera device listing, snapshot capture, and video clip recording with associated UI feedback and error handling.

methods.name: handleList
methods.description: Lists available camera devices and returns their details in JSON format.

methods.name: handleSnap
methods.description: Captures a snapshot using the camera, manages UI updates, logs, and error handling.

methods.name: handleClip
methods.description: Records a video clip, checks payload size, encodes clip to base64, manages UI updates, logs, and error handling.

methods.name: parseIncludeAudio
methods.description: Parses JSON parameters to determine if audio should be included during recording.

methods.name: isCameraClipWithinPayloadLimit
methods.description: Checks whether the clip size is within the maximum allowed payload size.
